translation_notes: Each graph.objects(subject, uri(pred)) with a fixed predicate string built by string concatenation becomes m{ {subject} f<{pred}> ?o }: the predicate is already a full IRI string, so f<...> (no percent-encoding) is the exact fit, not the bare {expr} coercion which would make it a Literal.
A shim.py supplies _RMLF/_FNML_OLD, missing from the extracted region's context (defined earlier in the source module).

repair.driver: fixture_cases.ttl in the shape the repository parses (blank-node function executions, picked off an IRI root by the driver for both sides) with seven calls: reference AND nested function on one inputValueMap (`if found: continue`), nested function under the legacy fnml:functionExecution, both reference predicates and two columns under one predicate, a falsy reference "" beside a function, zero solutions with neighbours sharing two of three terms of each pattern, a literal input, and a Literal passed as fe.
mutants_killed: f<{rp}> / f<{in_pred}> / f<{ivm_pred}> -> one fixed predicate each
subject of each of the four patterns widened to [] (extra columns or RecursionError)

optimization_notes: optimized.py: the four double loops `for pred in PREDS: for x in graph.objects(s, uri(pred))` go through one local helper `objects(subject, preds)` that flattens them in the same order (a list comprehension, read eagerly; the graph is not modified meanwhile, so the recursion sees the same triples); the `uri` alias goes with them. The `found` flag becomes `refs = {str(r) ...}`, added to `cols` and tested for emptiness: a reference "" still makes `refs` non-empty, so the nested function is still skipped.

optimized.ldpy, from optimized.py: the helper's read becomes `m{ {subject} f<{pred}> ?o }(graph)` (the predicate is a full IRI string, hence `f<…>`), and the local `import rdflib`, which only served URIRef, goes. A call suffix rather than `@graph graph`: the single island sits in a nested function. No exception to the symmetry rule.
header_optimization_notes: Nothing unused in either header: the shim import and the four predicate tuples are all read by the region, and there is no @prefix line. optimized_header.py and optimized_header.ldpy are copies of the optimized artefacts.
